note: The owner's copy rule for every post, page and card (2026-10-09): report, do not promote. No price talk, no promises, no calls to buy, no 'coming soon', no hype punctuation. Since 2026-10-10 also no prizes: nothing is ever won, things are only burned (the receipt is the product, a season is a scoreboard of burns). The draft script lints every template before printing and refuses on a hit; `scripts/burnkeeper-post-draft.mts lint <text|file>` lints anything else. Patterns are JavaScript regexes applied case-insensitively after the ALLOWED spans are masked out. References: docs/launch/x-burnticker-profile.md § Voice rules; src/lib/burnKeeper/statusPage.ts COPY RULE (SPEC §9.2); docs/launch/daily-post.md § Lint.

price-returns.ref: x-burnticker-profile.md § Voice rules: 'Nothing about price, ever'; SPEC §9.2
price-returns.why: a report says what supply did; it never says what price did or does

promises.ref: x-burnticker-profile.md § Voice rules: no promises; x-threads.md header
promises.why: the rule is the only promise; everything else is a report of what already happened

calls-to-buy.ref: x-burnticker-profile.md § Voice rules: 'Never a call to buy'
calls-to-buy.why: trade links live on the pages, not in posts

urgency.ref: x-burnticker-profile.md § Voice rules: no countdowns to a listing, no urgency
urgency.why: urgency is a sales device; receipts have no deadline

hype-punctuation.why: three exclamation marks or a rocket is a promise in costume

no-prizes.ref: x-burnticker-profile.md § Voice rules: 'Nothing is ever won — things are only burned' (owner, 2026-10-10)
no-prizes.why: a burn is a receipt, not a prize; a season is a scoreboard of burns, a champion is a stat; nobody is paid on any result

no-affiliation.ref: owner decision 2026-10-10 (anti-misrepresentation): a coin never claims a tie to anyone
no-affiliation.why: a creator's name, ticker or note must not suggest an official tie, an endorsement, a partnership or a guarantee by a team, league, candidate, agency or market
